name: agentchess
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y stockfish && pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel && pip install -e '.[mcp,dev]' && ([ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env) && chmod 600 .env
postAttachCommand: echo 'Start the GUI with: agentchess serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000'

KILO_API_KEY.description: Kilo Gateway API key (optional, for examples/kilo_*.yaml)

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key (optional, for built-in Claude players)
